nodes.text:
After China, Malaysia sees surge in HMPV cases; India, Japan, Hong Kong heighten vigilance

Malaysia, as per a Strait Times report, has seen a significant rise in cases of HMPV in 2024, with 327 cases reported, marking a 45 percent increase from 225 cases in 2023.
